articles.title: China Sends Two Giant Pandas to the United States
articles.summary: Two giant pandas named Ping Ping and Fu Shuang have arrived in Atlanta, USA, after flying on a special charter plane from China. The pandas landed at Atlanta's international airport in the early hours of the morning. Giant pandas are one of the world's rarest animals and are owned by China, which lends them to other countries as a sign of friendship. This kind of arrangement is often called 'panda diplomacy.' Zoos that receive pandas must promise to care for them carefully and support conservation efforts. The arrival of these two pandas marks an important moment in relations between China and the United States.

lv1: What are the names of the two pandas that arrived in the United States? (抵達美國的兩隻熊貓名字是什麼？)
Which city in the USA did the pandas fly to? (熊貓飛往美國哪個城市？)
lv2: Why does China lend pandas to other countries instead of giving them away permanently? (為什麼中國只是借出熊貓，而不是永久送給其他國家？)
How do you think the arrival of giant pandas can help people learn more about wildlife conservation? (你認為大熊貓的到來怎樣幫助人們更了解野生動物保育？)
lv3: Some people argue that 'panda diplomacy' is more about political image than genuine conservation. Do you agree or disagree, and why? (有人認為「熊貓外交」更多是為了政治形象而非真正保育。你同意嗎？為什麼？)

Should rare animals like giant pandas be kept in foreign zoos far from their natural habitat, or should all conservation efforts happen in their home country? Discuss different perspectives. (像大熊貓這樣的珍稀動物應該在遠離自然棲息地的外國動物園飼養，還是所有保育工作都應在其原居地進行？試從不同角度討論。)

articles.title: Severe Flooding Hits Bangkok After Days of Heavy Rain
articles.summary: The Thai capital Bangkok has been struck by serious flooding after several consecutive days of extremely heavy rainfall. City authorities declared a flood emergency across the entire city. Reports indicate that in some areas, floodwater reached depths of up to 40 centimetres by last Saturday. Flooding in big cities can cause major problems — it can damage homes and businesses, block roads, and put people's health at risk. Officials are working to pump water away and help affected residents. Climate scientists warn that intense rainstorms are becoming more frequent in Southeast Asia due to global warming, making floods like this harder to prevent.

lv1: Which country's capital city was hit by severe flooding? (哪個國家的首都遭受嚴重水災？)
How deep was the floodwater in some parts of the city? (部分地區的洪水有多深？)
lv2: Why can heavy flooding in a big city like Bangkok cause so many different problems for people living there? (為什麼像曼谷這樣的大城市發生嚴重水災，會為居民帶來這麼多不同的問題？)
How might climate change be connected to more frequent and severe flooding in Southeast Asia? (氣候變化與東南亞更頻繁和嚴重的洪水有什麼關係？)
lv3: Who should be responsible for protecting cities from flood disasters — local governments, national governments, or individuals? Give reasons for your view. (誰應該負責保護城市免受洪水災害——地方政府、中央政府還是個人？請說明你的立場。)

Developing countries in Southeast Asia often have fewer resources to deal with climate-related disasters. Is it fair that wealthier countries, which produce more carbon emissions, face fewer consequences? Discuss. (東南亞發展中國家往往資源較少，難以應對氣候相關災害。富裕國家排放更多碳卻面對較少後果，這公平嗎？試討論。)

articles.title: 名古屋亞運場地單車今日開賽　港隊全力爭獎牌
articles.summary: 2026年名古屋亞洲運動會今日（29日）迎來場地單車項目正式開幕，香港代表隊將全力出賽，力爭獎牌。與此同時，受雨水影響，羽毛球男單港將黃澤林需要靜候出賽安排。亞運會是亞洲規模最大的綜合運動會，吸引數十個國家和地區參與，每四年舉辦一次。運動員為國家爭光，需要多年刻苦訓練。今屆亞運在日本名古屋舉行，是香港運動員展示實力的重要舞台。

lv1: 今屆亞洲運動會在哪個城市舉行？
香港今日有哪個運動項目開賽？
lv2: 為什麼運動員要花多年時間訓練，才能參加亞洲運動會這類大型比賽？
天氣因素如何影響戶外運動項目的賽事安排？
lv3: 香港政府應否投放更多資源培育年輕運動員？這樣做對社會有什麼好處和壞處？
有人認為獎牌數目代表一個地方的體育發展水平，你同意嗎？除了獎牌，還有什麼指標可以衡量體育發展是否成功？

articles.title: 中美領導人會面　雙方公布多項合作共識
articles.summary: 中國國家主席習近平與美國總統特朗普近日舉行會面，兩國政府隨後分別公布雙方達成的合作共識清單。據報道，協議內容包括在尊重基礎上建立兩國關係框架，涵蓋貿易、科技及其他範疇的合作方向。中美兩國是全球最大的兩個經濟體，兩國關係對全世界都有深遠影響。外界普遍認為，此次會面是近年中美關係的重要里程碑，有助緩和雙方緊張局勢，推動更多國際合作。

lv1: 哪兩個國家的領導人近日舉行了重要會面？
兩國公布的共識涉及哪些主要範疇？
lv2: 為什麼中美兩國的關係對其他國家也有重要影響？
外交會談和談判對解決國與國之間的分歧有什麼作用？
lv3: 有人認為大國之間的外交合作比競爭更能解決全球問題，你同意嗎？請從不同角度分析。
中美關係影響香港的經濟和社會發展。你認為香港在中美關係中應扮演什麼角色？
